scenario: A data journalist scrapes a public city government spending-disclosure page to collect vendor payment records, runs statistical analysis on the extracted dataset to identify top recipients and average contract sizes, and then writes a structured news story summarizing the findings.
info_flow: web-scraper fetches the public spending page and outputs a structured CSV of payment records with a data_quality label per row → ub2-csv-data-analyzer filters to high-quality rows, computes summary statistics (totals, averages, top vendors) → reporting writes a formatted news story citing those statistics.
